answers.description: Mount Independence State Historic Site Museum is open seasonally May through October (check website for exact dates). During the season admissison fees are charged for trails and museum. During the off-season, the museum is closed and the trails are free.

answers.poi_name: Ballard Institute and Museum of Puppetry
answers.description: The Ballard Institute and Museum of Puppetry is one of America’s hidden treasures—a superb collection of over 3,500 puppets from all over the world; an archive of books, manuscripts, posters, drawings, audio-visual materials and photographs.
